# OBSERVER COST LEDGER

**Generated by:** `tests/performance/benchmark_cost_ledger.py`

Phase 1 left ~0.8 ms/step unattributed at the largest workload — about 60 %
of the total cost. This ledger measures each candidate component in isolation
and reconciles the parts against the whole.

## Reconciliation

| Workload | Baseline | Observed core overhead | Accounted | **Residual** | Dispersion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| tiny (4L, d32) | 4.69 ms | +0.65 ms (+13.8 %) | 3.39 ms | **-2.75 ms (-425 % of observed)** | ±0.46 ms |
| medium (8L, d128) | 18.36 ms | +0.80 ms (+4.4 %) | 3.68 ms | **-2.88 ms (-360 % of observed)** | ±1.15 ms |
| large (12L, d256) | 43.88 ms | +4.36 ms (+9.9 %) | 4.90 ms | **-0.55 ms (-13 % of observed)** | ±4.91 ms |
